aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.build: We build practical software specifically for food trucks and mobile catering, which helps them take online orders, keep track of collection times, keep orders flowing and spend less time on repeated questions.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was founded to change that.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet a large part of the software available to them is designed for businesses with a fixed address.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our goal is simple: to make running a food truck easier, with tools designed around how these businesses actually operate.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab began with a simple observation: food trucks need better tools to run their businesses.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After I created Village Foodie, a directory that helps people find food trucks coming to their home area, I looked more closely at the challenges mobile food sellers face. Unlike traditional restaurants, food trucks are constantly on the move, work in different places and serve customers in changing conditions.

comparison.faq.capacityA: Customers only see collection times the kitchen can actually handle. The system works from each dish's preparation time and how many you make at once.
comparison.faq.capacityQ: How does the system prevent my kitchen being overloaded?
comparison.faq.costA: {plans}. Online card payments also carry Stripe's fees: {cardFee} per card payment.
comparison.faq.costTrial: {months, plural, one {The first month is} other {The first # months are}} free, with all features.
comparison.faq.locationsA: Yes. You set up the weekly schedule with places and times and customers order for the place and day you are there.
comparison.faq.locationsQ: Does it work with changing locations?
comparison.faq.paymentsA: Customers pay online by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, or pay at the truck. PayPal and Klarna are not supported at the moment.
comparison.faq.paymentsQ: Which payment methods does HatchGrab support?
comparison.faq.termA: No. There is no minimum term and no notice period. You can cancel any time; the fee is billed monthly in advance and you keep access until the end of the month you have paid for.
comparison.faq.termQ: Is there any minimum contract term?
comparison.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
comparison.faq.tseA: HatchGrab is not a till and has no TSE. How you record online orders in the till is a question for your tax adviser.
comparison.faq.tseQ: Do I still need a till with a TSE?
comparison.faq.whatA: An ordering system takes orders online before customers reach the truck: they choose dishes and a collection time, pay online or on collection, and the order appears in your kitchen. A till or card reader takes payment at the truck. The two complement each other.
comparison.faq.whatQ: What is an ordering system for food trucks?

featuresPage.detail.accountant_reports: Sales, tax and refunds for any month, quarter or tax year, ready to download for your bookkeeper.
featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers order for a particular day or time before the event.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — no need to confirm each and every one.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Put your logo on the QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: Record a buzzer number on the order when you hand it out, so you know which buzzer belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen customers see, with order numbers and when the orders are ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your truck appears on the public HatchGrab map so customers nearby can find you.
featuresPage.detail.documents_reminders: Keep your certificates in one place, e.g. for food safety, insurance and gas safety. We remind you before anything expires, and you can send them to an event or market organiser with one tap.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show the next dates on your own website. Each of them links straight to its ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types, with special prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The most powerful way to use HatchGrab: a live kitchen screen and the only way to keep taking orders when the signal drops.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much the kitchen can cook at once and how long it takes. When a time slot is fully booked, customers can’t choose it.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward regular customers with digital stamp cards — stamps are collected and redeemed automatically.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Put items together into deals and offer add-ons at checkout to raise the average order amount.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: Like automatic replies on WhatsApp, for enquiries on Messenger and Instagram.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Use several screens — at the counter and in the kitchen — that all show the same orders in real time.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give staff their own login with the right access permissions.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If the signal drops, online orders pause so customers can’t send orders you don’t see. With the app for iPhone, iPad and Android you keep taking orders without a connection; the web dashboard needs a connection.

landing.does.capacityBody: Set how much you can cook at once and how long it takes. When a collection time is fully booked, customers can’t choose it.
landing.does.devicesBody: Runs on the phone in your apron pocket, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the truck — and the card terminal you already take payments with.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume a fixed address, a reliable network and the same opening hours every week. You are in a new place every week, at different times, with patchy or no mobile signal. HatchGrab was built exactly for that.
landing.does.offlineBody: If the signal drops, online orders pause automatically so customers can’t send orders you don’t see. Keep taking orders in the app for iPhone, iPad and Android.
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you already post on Facebook or Instagram. We fill in dates, places and times, ready to share — every week or every day.
landing.does.postsTitle: Automatic posts on Facebook and Instagram
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers order ahead and choose a collection time. Shorter queues, and the food ready when they turn up.
landing.does.title: Designed for food trucks, not restaurants.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” WhatsApp messages get answered while you drive to the pitch or stand at the grill, based on your own menu and schedule. Messenger and Instagram are coming.

offlineProtection.disableConfirm:
Switch off protection against lost connection for this event?

If this device loses connection, online orders continue — customers could order without you seeing it. Only switch this off if you have a reliable connection.

Protection against lost connection switched on.

For orders to keep arriving, the screen must stay on. If this device loses connection, the protection takes over in the mode you chose.

Make sure “Screen always on” is switched on in this device.
